verdict.rationale: Codegen's own docs say agents can update statuses, add comments, link PRs to issues and create tasks, with explicit support for Jira, Linear, ClickUp and Monday.com. The integrations API also lists all four as OAuth-based integrations, and dedicated pages cover Linear and ClickUp. Missing for 10: dedicated per-integration docs for Jira and Monday.com showing ticket-management depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can connect issue trackers like Jira, Linear, ClickUp, or Monday.com so agents can manage tickets directly

citations.quote: Update statuses, add comments, link PRs to issues, and create new tasks. Support for Jira, Linear, Clickup and Monday.com.
